rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone whose appearance does not seem to age.

example.english: Your mum takes good care of herself; she looks truly ageless.
example.traditional: 你阿媽保養得好，真係唔顯老。
example.jyutping: nei5 aa3 maa1 bou2 joeng5 dak1 hou2 zan1 hai6 m4 hin2 lou5

rows.note: Use this for something extremely ancient, rather than for a person who still looks young.

example.english: This ancient stone bridge has stood for hundreds of years and feels ageless.
example.traditional: 呢座古老嘅石橋，行咗幾百年喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gu2 lou5 ge3 sek6 kiu4 haang4 zo2 gei2 baak3 nin4 laa3
